summary: WF Card Funding LLC, as depositor for the issuing entity WF Card Issuance Trust, filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of Class A(2026-1) Notes on April 27, 2026. The transferor interest was $2,652,782,740.04 (~40.81% of outstanding investor ABS interests) to comply with U.S. risk retention rules. This is a routine structured finance ABS note issuance under a shelf registration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven transaction is involved.
